name: Усунення захисника: відволікання (2)
description:
Defenders of a mating square can be lured away. This is shown in the examples.


In example 1 White uses a decoy sacrifice for a checkmating attack!


In example 2 White does not need a sacrifice to lure away the defender. Once again, he has spotted an overloaded piece.


What do you have to do?

Beat the defender of a mating square by luring it away.

examples.text: An overload situation for Black. The knight has to defend two mating squares. That is one too many. White sacrifices a rook to lure away the knight. On the next move, the other rook checkmates.

Here, White does not need a decoy sacrifice to get rid of the defender. The knight defends both the bishop and a mating square. Oops, overload!


White can take the bishop. If Black recaptures, White can checkmate. But what if Black does not take back the bishop? Then it was a free capture for White!

texts: The black queen is a key defender.
